purpose: Prospective scope_v2 regression: 12 original contracts plus 27 contrastive synthetic cases; not independent final evaluation
promotion: Never automatic. At least one backend must pass all automated gates; semantic evidence review and broader regression are still required before any integration.
limitations: Twelve assistant-authored synthetic contracts have already been inspected. They are development regressions, not independent held-out data.
Each verifier sees only claim/context; proposed labels and gold labels are used by the scorer after inference. Blinding does not make model errors statistically independent.
Exact quote membership is a necessary grounding check, not proof that the quote entails the label.
Historical repair scores at threshold 0.7 are compared with discrete label agreement. Agreement is not a calibrated confidence probability.
Verifier uses a 384-token output budget versus 192 in the historical confidence run; latency/cost differences are not a controlled causal comparison.
The serving repair pipeline, thresholds and Writer gate are not changed by this experiment.
The 27 new cases cover nine contrast sets with support/contradict/NEI variants; they are assistant-authored development data, with independent annotation review pending.
The scorer tests all three labels per unique prediction: 117 comparisons reuse only 39 cases, not 117 independent observations.
Historical base verifier and confidence repair are compared only on the original 12 contracts; no baseline is claimed for newly authored cases.
Prompt, data and gate hashes are frozen before inference; passing automation still requires semantic and independent review before integration.
